segments.ja499:1.3: Ekanettā bhavissāma, cakkhuṃ me dehi yācito.
segments.ja499:2.1: Kenānusiṭṭho idha māgatosi, vanibbaka [vaṇibbaka (sī.)] cakkhupathāni yācituṃ;
segments.ja499:2.3: Suduccajaṃ yācasi uttamaṅgaṃ, yamāhu nettaṃ purisena duccajaṃ.
segments.ja499:3.1: Yamāhu devesu sujampatīti, maghavāti naṃ āhu manussaloke;
segments.ja499:3.3: Tenānusiṭṭho idha māgatosmi, vanibbako cakkhupathāni yācituṃ.
segments.ja499:4.1: Vanibbato [vanibbako (syā. pī.)] mayha vaniṃ [vanaṃ (ka.), vaṇiṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] anuttaraṃ, dadāhi te cakkhupathāni yācito;
segments.ja499:4.3: Dadāhi me cakkhupathaṃ anuttaraṃ, yamāhu nettaṃ purisena duccajaṃ.
segments.ja499:5.3: Te te ijjhantu saṅkappā, labha cakkhūni brāhmaṇa.
segments.ja499:6.3: Sa cakkhumā gaccha janassa pekkhato, yadicchase tvaṃ tadate samijjhatu.
segments.ja499:7.1: Mā no deva adā cakkhuṃ, mā no sabbe parākari [parakkari (syā. ka. aṭṭha.), parikkari (ka.) pari + ā + kari = parākari];
segments.ja499:7.3: Dhanaṃ dehi mahārāja, muttā veḷuriyā bahū.
segments.ja499:8.1: Yutte deva rathe dehi, ājānīye calaṅkate;
segments.ja499:9.1: Yathā taṃ sivayo [sīviyo (syā.)] sabbe, sayoggā sarathā sadā;
segments.ja499:9.3: Samantā parikireyyuṃ [parikareyyuṃ (syā. pī.)], evaṃ dehi rathesabha.
segments.ja499:10.1: Yo ve dassanti vatvāna, adāne kurute mano;
segments.ja499:10.3: Bhūmyaṃ [bhūmyā (sī. pī.)] so patitaṃ pāsaṃ, gīvāyaṃ paṭimuñcati.
segments.ja499:11.1: Yo ve dassanti vatvāna, adāne kurute mano;
segments.ja499:12.1: Yañhi yāce tañhi dade, yaṃ na yāce na taṃ dade;
segments.ja499:12.3: Svāhaṃ tameva dassāmi, yaṃ maṃ yācati brāhmaṇo.
segments.ja499:13.1: Āyuṃ nu vaṇṇaṃ nu sukhaṃ balaṃ nu, kiṃ patthayāno nu janinda desi;
segments.ja499:13.3: Kathañhi rājā sivinaṃ anuttaro, cakkhūni dajjā paralokahetu.
segments.ja499:14.1: Na vāhametaṃ yasasā dadāmi, na puttamicche na dhanaṃ na raṭṭhaṃ;
segments.ja499:14.3: Satañca dhammo carito purāṇo, icceva dāne ramate mano mama [mamaṃ (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja499:15.1: Sakhā ca mitto ca mamāsi sīvika [sīvaka (sī. pī.)], susikkhito sādhu karohi me vaco;
segments.ja499:15.3: Uddharitvā [uddhatva (sī.), laddha tvaṃ (pī.)] cakkhūni mamaṃ jigīsato, hatthesu ṭhapehi [āvesi (sī.)] vanibbakassa.
segments.ja499:16.5: Sacakkhu brāhmaṇo āsi, andho rājā upāvisi.
segments.ja499:19.1: So ca pokkharaṇītīre [pokkharaṇiyā tīre (sī. pī.)], pallaṅkena upāvisi;
segments.ja499:20.3: Varaṃ varassu rājīsi, yaṃ kiñci manasicchasi.
segments.ja499:21.1: Pahūtaṃ me dhanaṃ sakka, balaṃ koso canappako;
segments.ja499:21.3: Andhassa me sato dāni, maraṇaññeva ruccati.
segments.ja499:22.1: Yāni saccāni dvipadinda, tāni bhāsassu khattiya;
segments.ja499:22.3: Saccaṃ te bhaṇamānassa, puna cakkhu bhavissati.
segments.ja499:23.3: Yopi maṃ yācate tattha, sopi me manaso piyo;
segments.ja499:24.1: Yaṃ maṃ so yācituṃ āgā, dehi cakkhunti brāhmaṇo;
segments.ja499:24.3: Tassa cakkhūni pādāsiṃ, brāhmaṇassa vanibbato [vaṇibbino (sī.), vanibbino (pī.)].
segments.ja499:28.1: Ko nīdha vittaṃ na dadeyya yācito, api visiṭṭhaṃ supiyampi attano;
segments.ja499:28.3: Tadiṅgha sabbe sivayo samāgatā, dibbāni nettāni mamajja passatha.
segments.ja499:30.1: Na cāgamattā paramatthi kiñci, maccānaṃ idha jīvite;
segments.ja499:30.3: Datvāna mānusaṃ [datvā mānusakaṃ (sī.)] cakkhuṃ, laddhaṃ me [me iti padaṃ natthi sī. potthake] cakkhuṃ amānusaṃ.
segments.ja499:31.1: Etampi disvā sivayo, detha dānāni bhuñjatha;
segments.ja499:31.3: Datvā ca bhutvā ca yathānubhāvaṃ, aninditā saggamupetha ṭhānanti.
